title: CueFX render job (one look)
description: Returned by generate and by job updates (generate: task 18), and by the manual render (task 21: POST /api/manual/{id}/result, GET /api/jobs, GET /api/jobs/{id}). v2.3 adds status waiting and the optional manual, clip_id, make_key, files and warnings. v2.4: a manual export may be running (stage 0, Preparing shot) before it is waiting.

status.description: waiting (v2.3): a manual job whose package is exported; it waits for the LTX result to be uploaded

manual.description: v2.3: true for a manual render (exported, run by hand in ComfyUI, result uploaded); missing means false

clip_id.description: v2.3: the clip the job renders on

make_key.description: v2.3: the Make key of the cue and look the job was made for

files.description: v2.3: download/preview URLs that exist now

final_preview.description: done: the final video, browser H.264, inline

final_download.description: done: the same file, as an attachment

warnings.description: v2.3: plain-text notes from the steps (degrade, don't fail)
